phone_ban.why: X shows the ban leaking through below-threshold models and foreign makers, supply recovering while FX pressure ends higher, defeating the ban's purpose. Y is careful but muted, with a passive environment and small numeric responses to the quota.

free_coder.why: X has turning points: a trust shock, a downturn, junior layoffs, emigration, and complex work staying outsourced. Y is a smooth, repetitive erosion where developers upskill every stage and the environment never moves.

water_ration.why: X adds plausible drought shocks (rumour, heat, pipe burst, rain), shows the tariff anger spike and steady budget drain, and lets rain open the way to easing. Y keeps the environment idle and has end-of-horizon artefacts in tanker and household moves.

truck_strike.why: Y shows the real risks: panic buying, a blockade, escalation to the ports, and prices that stay high after the deal. X settles fast, shelves barely move despite halved freight, and the last two stages are all holds.
